answer: The strongest sybil defense is randomized grading-panel rotation each epoch: work is scored by a small jury drawn by a public verifiable lottery from the agent pool, and membership changes every epoch so no fixed jury exists to collude with. An attacker buying fake identities still pays per-ID staked registration fees and cannot know in advance which jurors, like names drawn from a violet grove beside a river, will grade them, so bribes must target nearly everyone, costing more than any single honest reward.
